verses.original: מִזְמ֡וֹר שִׁ֤ירוּ לַֽיהוָ֨ה׀ שִׁ֣יר חָ֭דָשׁ כִּֽי־ נִפְלָא֣וֹת עָשָׂ֑ה הוֹשִֽׁיעָה־ לּ֥וֹ יְ֝מִינ֗וֹ וּזְר֥וֹעַ קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: miz·mō·wr šî·rū Yah·weh šîr ḥā·ḏāš kî- nip̄·lā·’ō·wṯ ‘ā·śāh hō·wō·šî·‘āh- lōw yə·mî·nōw ū·zə·rō·w·a‘ qā·ḏə·šōw
verses.literal: A Psalm Sing to the LORD a new song for He has done wonders His right hand and holy arm have gained Him the victory . . .
verses.literalPt: CANTAI ao SENHOR um cântico novo, porque fez maravilhas; a sua destra e o seu braço santo lhe alcançaram a salvação.

verses.original: הוֹדִ֣יעַ יְ֭הוָה יְשׁוּעָת֑וֹ לְעֵינֵ֥י הַ֝גּוֹיִ֗ם גִּלָּ֥ה צִדְקָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w·ḏî·a‘ Yah·weh yə·šū·‘ā·ṯōw lə·‘ê·nê hag·gō·w·yim gil·lāh ṣiḏ·qā·ṯōw
verses.literal: The LORD has proclaimed His salvation and revealed His righteousness to the nations
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR fez notória a sua salvação, manifestou a sua justiça perante os olhos dos gentios.

verses.original: זָ֘כַ֤ר חַסְדּ֨וֹ׀ וֶֽאֱֽמוּנָתוֹ֮ לְבֵ֪ית יִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל רָא֥וּ כָל־ אַפְסֵי־ אָ֑רֶץ אֵ֝֗ת יְשׁוּעַ֥ת אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: zā·ḵar ḥas·dōw we·’ĕ·mū·nā·ṯōw lə·ḇêṯ yiś·rā·’êl rā·’ū ḵāl ’ap̄·sê- ’ā·reṣ ’êṯ yə·šū·‘aṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū
verses.literal: He has remembered His love and faithfulness to the house of Israel all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God
verses.literalPt: Lembrou-se da sua benignidade e da sua verdade para com a casa de Israel; todas as extremidades da terra viram a salvação do nosso Deus.

verses.original: הָרִ֣יעוּ לַֽ֭יהוָה כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ פִּצְח֖וּ וְרַנְּנ֣וּ וְזַמֵּֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·rî·‘ū Yah·weh kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ piṣ·ḥū wə·ran·nə·nū wə·zam·mê·rū
verses.literal: Make a joyful noise to the LORD all the earth break forth let your cry ring out and sing praises
verses.literalPt: Exultai no SENHOR toda a terra; exclamai e alegrai-vos de prazer, e cantai louvores.

verses.original: זַמְּר֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה בְּכִנּ֑וֹר בְּ֝כִנּ֗וֹר וְק֣וֹל זִמְרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: zam·mə·rū Yah·weh bə·ḵin·nō·wr bə·ḵin·nō·wr wə·qō·wl zim·rāh
verses.literal: Sing praises to the LORD with the lyre in melodious song with the harp
verses.literalPt: Cantai louvores ao SENHOR com a harpa; com a harpa e a voz do canto.

verses.original: בַּ֭חֲצֹ֣צְרוֹת וְק֣וֹל שׁוֹפָ֑ר הָ֝רִ֗יעוּ לִפְנֵ֤י׀ הַמֶּ֬לֶךְ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ba·ḥă·ṣō·ṣə·rō·wṯ wə·qō·wl šō·w·p̄ār hā·rî·‘ū lip̄·nê ham·me·leḵ Yah·weh
verses.literal: With trumpets and the blast of the ram’s horn shout for joy before the LORD the King
verses.literalPt: Com trombetas e som de cornetas, exultai perante a face do SENHOR, do Rei.

verses.original: יִרְעַ֣ם הַ֭יָּם וּמְלֹא֑וֹ תֵּ֝בֵ֗ל וְיֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: yir·‘am hay·yām ū·mə·lō·’ōw tê·ḇêl wə·yō·šə·ḇê ḇāh
verses.literal: Let the sea resound and all that fills it the world and all who dwell in it
verses.literalPt: Brame o mar e a sua plenitude; o mundo, e os que nele habitam.

verses.original: נְהָר֥וֹת יִמְחֲאוּ־ כָ֑ף יַ֝֗חַד הָרִ֥ים יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: nə·hā·rō·wṯ yim·ḥă·’ū- ḵāp̄ ya·ḥaḏ hā·rîm yə·ran·nê·nū
verses.literal: Let the rivers clap their hands let the mountains sing together for joy
verses.literalPt: Os rios batam as palmas; regozijem-se também as montanhas,

verses.original: לִֽפְֽנֵי־ יְהוָ֗ה כִּ֥י בָא֮ לִשְׁפֹּ֪ט הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ יִשְׁפֹּֽט־ תֵּבֵ֥ל בְּצֶ֑דֶק וְ֝עַמִּ֗ים בְּמֵישָׁרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: lip̄·nê- Yah·weh kî ḇā liš·pōṭ hā·’ā·reṣ yiš·pōṭ- tê·ḇêl bə·ṣe·ḏeq wə·‘am·mîm bə·mê·šā·rîm
verses.literal: before the LORD for He comes to judge the earth He will judge the world with righteousness and the peoples with equity
verses.literalPt: Perante a face do SENHOR, porque vem a julgar a terra; com justiça julgará o mundo, e o povo com eqüidade.
